instruction: I am going on a trip to Bangkok with some of my friends. We are managing its planning on a Todoist project for it. One of the tasks in it is about preparing a Spotify playlist. I have made the playlist and shared it with others on the project. But they have made some suggestions in comments. Please incorporate them, leave a final comment, "Thanks! Updated.", and mark it complete.
notes: Suggestions in the task comments are modeled as static facts (suggested-add / suggested-remove) whose ids become usable only after todoist.show_task_comments sets (suggestions-read); songs to add are looked up with spotify.search_songs (one query object per song), songs to remove are read from spotify.show_playlist (playlist-contents-known). The number of suggestions (2 to add, 2 to remove) is an assumption matching the 17-call reference length; adjust the song objects/init facts if the actual comments differ. The playlist is located in the user's own library via show_playlist_library with a Bangkok query. supervisor.complete_task takes the task records as non-API parameters so its precondition literally equals the goal (with inequality constraints forcing all distinct suggested songs to be handled). Only is_completed is sent in update_task so the task's other fields stay untouched; exactly one new comment is posted.
